name: MMTC Ltd.
about: MMTC Limited operates as a trading company in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and North America. It operates through Minerals, Precious Metals, Metals, Agro Products, Coal & Hydrocarbon, Fertilizer, and General Trade/others segments. The company engages in the export of minerals; and import of precious metals, non-ferrous metals, fertilizers, agro products, coal and hydrocarbon, etc. It also trades in minerals, metals, fertilizers, agro products, coal and hydrocarbons, bullion, jewellery, and other commodities. MMTC Limited was incorporated in 1963 and is based in New Delhi, India.

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~22% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~-5% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 11.4% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 25 vs sector median 26; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 6, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, most of the 16% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 3 → 25), not earnings growth (-38% a year).
